This declares SCOPE, not a rule waiver. Every rule stays fully armed on
every first-party template, stylesheet and script. It exists so the scanned
surface is a property of the repository rather than of whichever paths a
given run happens to pass on the command line -- an earlier run scanned
'templates static/css static/js' and a later one 'templates static', and the
24-finding difference between them was pure scope drift, which is exactly
the kind of ambiguity that makes a conformance number unciteable.
